description:
Estimate the total fare for a cross-system trip: per-leg fares, how to pay
each, and a total — noting each leg is usually a separate payment. Origin and
destination can be addresses, places, stations or "lat,lon".

Answer only from this tool's results: never add routes, hours, phone numbers, addresses or tips from memory. Unofficial tool, not affiliated with WMATA or any transit agency.
name: estimate_trip_cost
title: Trip cost estimate
